title: Smart Class Scheduling
subtitle: Prepare inputs, review suggested plans, and publish the final schedule

workflow.title: Scheduling workflow
workflow.description: The system checks term data, creates valid alternatives, and keeps the final decision with the supervisor.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.description: Complete class requirements and availability data.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: The engine creates and ranks conflict-free alternatives.

review.title: Supervisor review
review.description: Compare suggestions and adjust details when needed.

publish.title: Publish classes
publish.description: Validate the selected plan and convert it into real classes.

ready.title: Your scheduling workspace is ready
ready.description: Before creating the first plan, review the active term, teacher qualifications and availability, and student time profiles.

generation.title: Create scheduling suggestions
generation.description: Choose the scheduling scope and the class requirements the engine should include.

branch.label: Branch scope
branch.description: Optional — narrow the suggestions to one branch.

requirements.label: Class requirements
requirements.description: Select at least one active requirement to schedule.
requirements.empty: No active requirements match this scope
requirements.emptyHint: First calculate and save class requirements for this term from the Course Demand tab.
requirements.chooseTermHint: Active class requirements for that term will appear here.

validation.requirements: Select at least one class requirement.

instituteRequired.title: Select an institute
instituteRequired.description: Choose an institute from the header before starting a scheduling run.

QUEUED.title: Waiting to start
QUEUED.description: The request is queued and will start automatically. You can keep this page open.

GENERATING.title: Generating scheduling suggestions
GENERATING.description: The engine is checking constraints and ranking the available scheduling options.

COMPLETED.title: Suggestions are ready
COMPLETED.description: Generation finished successfully and the plans are ready for supervisor review.

PREFLIGHT_FAILED.title: Inputs need attention
PREFLIGHT_FAILED.description: Generation could not start because one or more required inputs are incomplete or incompatible.

FAILED.title: Generation failed
FAILED.description: The engine could not finish this run. Review the message below and try again.

CANCELLED.title: Generation was cancelled
CANCELLED.description: This run stopped before producing scheduling suggestions.

connectionError.title: Status could not be refreshed
connectionError.description: The run is still preserved. Check your connection and try refreshing its status.

notFound.title: Scheduling Run Not Found
notFound.description: This run was not found or may belong to another institute.

result.title: {count} scheduling suggestions generated
result.description: Review the generated alternatives and choose the best fit.

preflightIssues.title: Preflight blocking issues:
preflightIssues.COURSE_WITHOUT_QUALIFIED_TEACHER: Course "{entity}" does not have an active qualified teacher. Please assign course qualification to at least one teacher.
preflightIssues.COURSE_WITHOUT_AVAILABLE_TEACHER: None of the qualified teachers for course "{entity}" have submitted time availabilities.
preflightIssues.COURSE_WITHOUT_PHASE_AVAILABILITY: Qualified teachers for course "{entity}" have no availability covering an exact slot in the selected term's operating phase.
preflightIssues.NO_CLASSROOM_WITH_REQUIRED_CAPACITY: No classroom meets the capacity requirement for one of the courses.
preflightIssues.INCOMPLETE_STUDENT_SCHEDULE_DATA: Some student schedules have incomplete availability data.
preflightIssues.NO_ELIGIBLE_STUDENTS: No eligible students found for this course.
preflightIssues.TEACHERS_WITHOUT_COURSE_QUALIFICATION: Some active teachers have no course qualifications assigned.

comparison.title: Compare suggested plans
comparison.description: Review every option against the same criteria and choose the best fit.

loading.title: Preparing the comparison
loading.description: Loading the details of the generated plans.

error.title: Plan comparison could not be loaded
error.description: The run result is safe. Try loading the plan details again.

planDetails.title: Plan {rank} details
planDetails.description: Review the suggested classes and unresolved requirements before making a final decision.
planDetails.publishedDescription: This plan is published and its operational classes have been created.

notFound.title: Scheduling plan not found
notFound.description: The plan details could not be found or may belong to a different institute.

noProposals.title: No feasible classes were generated
noProposals.description: Review the unresolved requirements below to understand why.

planDetails.unresolvedDescription: Student demand exceeded available teacher hours or physical classroom capacity, so these courses could not be scheduled.

warningMessages.GENERATION_PENDING: This plan has not finished generating.
warningMessages.MISSING_SCHEDULED_CLASSES: Some required classes could not be generated.
warningMessages.NEUTRAL_TIME_GROUP_USED: A neutral time group was used.
warningMessages.TIME_PATTERN_NOT_DIVERSE: The odd/even or morning/evening mix is incomplete.
warningMessages.TIME_GROUP_IMBALANCED: Classes are not balanced across time groups.
warningMessages.MANUAL_EDIT_REQUIRES_VALIDATION: This class must be validated again after its manual edit.

warningContexts.classCount: {scheduled} of {required} required classes could be scheduled.

calendarView.subtitle: Weekly class schedule mapped by day and time

calendarView.noMissedClassesToAssign: All unscheduled classes have been scheduled in the calendar.
calendarView.emptyDaysNotice: Days without classes in this schedule: {days}

swapDialog.title: Swap Class

swapDialog.invalidCombination: This selected combination is not feasible due to teacher or classroom constraints.

unresolvedReasons.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: The class requirement is incomplete or invalid.
unresolvedReasons.NO_VALID_TEACHER: No active valid teacher was found.

recovery.title: Ways to place this class
recovery.emptyRooms: Physical rooms currently empty at this time
recovery.onlineRoom: No physical room is needed for this online class.
recovery.noEmptyRoom: No compatible physical room is empty at this time.
recovery.changeNeeded: Move one of these classes to free a room
recovery.blockingClass: Class {title} is using room {room} during this time.
recovery.teacherConflictDescriptionWithSuggestion: The teachers below are qualified for this course but teach another class during the current windows. The best exact time to request one additional class appears under Teacher staffing options.
recovery.teacherConflictDescriptionWithoutSuggest: The teachers below are qualified for this course but teach another class during the current windows, and no other conflict-free time was found. Consider adding another qualified teacher.
recovery.noOptionTitle: No concrete slot is available yet

reassignment.title: Teacher reassignment analysis
reassignment.description: The system checks whether another teacher is free at the same time and qualified for the same level, so they can take the busy teacher’s class and free that teacher to resolve this requirement.
reassignment.moveTeacher: {toTeacher} is free at this time and can teach {classTitle} instead of {fromTeacher}.
reassignment.noChainDescription: No safe combination was found within three reassignments. Locked classes remain unchanged, and qualifications, availability, conflicts, and the physical room are validated together.

validation.availability: Replacement teacher is free at this time

staffingFallback.title: Teacher staffing options
staffingFallback.description: The system evaluates two staffing paths: expanding a qualified teacher’s availability or adding a new teacher for this level.
staffingFallback.suggestedTimesRanking: Options are ranked by available room, time fit, and minimal schedule disruption.
staffingFallback.outreachTitle: Coordinate with {teacher} for an extra class
staffingFallback.noClassConflict: {teacher} has no other institute class during this window.
staffingFallback.alreadyAvailableInSlot: Teacher is already free on {days} from {start} to {end}; no schedule change needed.
staffingFallback.teacherFreeNotice: Teacher is free during this slot; no schedule change needed
staffingFallback.availabilityEmptyTitle: No suitable availability expansion was found
staffingFallback.availabilityEmptyDescription: No qualified teacher has a class-free window. Adding a new teacher remains an available staffing option.
staffingFallback.roomNeeded: This time works for the teacher, but a physical room must be arranged separately.
staffingFallback.online: This class is online and will not need a physical room after the teacher is freed.
staffingFallback.addTeacherDescriptionWithSchedule: Record this teaching qualification and the availability below for the new teacher. The time comes directly from the suggested schedule for unscheduled classes.
staffingFallback.addTeacherDescription: Adding a new teacher is still recommended, but the current plan could not produce an exact feasible time for this class.
staffingFallback.newTeacherTimesTitle: Suggested time for the new teacher
staffingFallback.newTeacherTimesDescription: Use the following days and time when arranging the new teacher’s contract or availability.
staffingFallback.newTeacherScheduleEmptyTitle: No exact time was found for this class
staffingFallback.newTeacherScheduleEmptyDescription: Review operating hours, breaks, or class duration. The recommendation to add a new teacher remains visible.
staffingFallback.acceptSuccess: Class assigned to teacher and teacher availability updated.
staffingFallback.revertSuccess: Class assignment and teacher availability expansion reverted.

hiringPlan.title: Suggested schedule for a new teacher
hiringPlan.description: To cover every unscheduled class, the system prioritizes an odd/even three-day pattern and consecutive times; when that is not feasible, it shows the best alternative.
hiringPlan.validation: The system checked physical rooms for the displayed days and times. An odd/even three-day pattern and consecutive times are preferences, not reasons to hide a suggestion.
hiringPlan.validationWithRoomChanges: This is the best time combination found, but one or more classes still need a free or additional physical room. An odd/even three-day pattern and consecutive times are preferences, not reasons to hide a suggestion.
hiringPlan.emptyTitle: No complete feasible schedule was found
hiringPlan.emptyDescription: Adding a new teacher is still recommended, but even with alternative days and time gaps, the current operating phase cannot fit every unscheduled class. Review operating hours, breaks, or class durations.
hiringPlan.commitSuccess: Draft classes successfully added to plan.

unfilledTeachers.title: Teachers with remaining free time
unfilledTeachers.description: Teachers whose available hours were not fully filled with classes in this plan and have free slots:
unfilledTeachers.allFilled: All teacher availability hours are fully occupied with classes in this plan.

all.title: All teacher calendars
all.description: Review availability, free periods, and occupied classes for every active teacher in one place.

qualified.title: Calendars for teachers related to this problem
qualified.description: Review the free periods and scheduled classes of teachers who can help resolve this requirement.

teacherCalendar.teacherSelector: Select a teacher to view their calendar
teacherCalendar.noTeachers: There are no active teachers to show in the calendar.
teacherCalendar.teachableLevels: Levels the selected teacher can teach
teacherCalendar.noTeachableLevels: No teachable level has been recorded for this teacher yet.
teacherCalendar.noAvailability: No availability is recorded for this day.

unresolvedSuggestions.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: Review the class requirement, requested class count, and target capacity, then run scheduling again.
unresolvedSuggestions.NO_VALID_TEACHER: Add at least one active teacher or review inactive teachers in teacher management.
unresolvedSuggestions.NO_QUALIFIED_TEACHER: Assign this course qualification to one or more active teachers.
unresolvedSuggestions.NO_TEACHER_AVAILABILITY: Add availability for qualified teachers that overlaps the institute operating phases.
unresolvedSuggestions.TEACHER_TIME_CONFLICT: Expand teacher availability, assign another qualified teacher, or review their overlapping classes.
unresolvedSuggestions.NO_COMPATIBLE_CLASSROOM: Add a classroom compatible with the branch and delivery mode, or review the delivery mode.
unresolvedSuggestions.INSUFFICIENT_CLASSROOM_CAPACITY: Use a larger classroom, reduce the group size, or split students across more classes.
unresolvedSuggestions.CLASSROOM_TIME_CONFLICT: Expand classroom availability, add another classroom, or change the scheduling window.
unresolvedSuggestions.NO_FEASIBLE_TIME_SLOT: Review operating phases, holidays, term dates, and teacher availability to create more feasible time slots.
unresolvedSuggestions.INSUFFICIENT_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATES: Create more options by expanding teacher and classroom availability or relaxing the requirement constraints.
unresolvedSuggestions.PLAN_COMBINATION_CONFLICT: Change this requirement’s time, teacher, or classroom, or review constraints on overlapping classes.
